# Copilot Instructions

The engineering rules for this repository live in `AGENTS.md` at the repo root.
Read it before proposing any change; it is the single source of truth for architecture,
layering, the non-negotiable rules, and the baseline ratchet.

The Definition of Done is `docs/DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md`.
A task is not complete until `npm run verify` exits 0.
